1. Executive summary

A read-only pre-UAT was completed against the KMSPKS JustLogin production tenant using the Admin account. Login, logout, session invalidation, dashboard, Action Center, People, Settings, Attendance, and several additional module routes were checked. No production data was changed.

Overall verdict: NOT READY for full-suite UAT.

The tenant is only partially provisioned for the requested full-suite scope. The sidebar exposes Home, Attendance, People, and Settings only, and Action Center reports 1 subscribed module (Overtime). Leave, Payroll, Benefits, and Onboarding were not available. Expense is accessible only by direct URL and renders a blank page with server errors. Approvals also renders blank.

Conditional position: limited UAT on Attendance, People (excluding the OED report), and Settings can proceed after the High items below are addressed or explicitly accepted.

Key results

  • Login, menu navigation, Action Center, People Info, most Settings pages, Attendance pages, logout, and post-logout URL blocking all worked.
  • High: OED statutory report cannot be completed — UEN is empty and the supporting API returns 404.
  • High (privacy): a third-party analytics/onboarding request includes the Admin user's email address and assigned admin roles in the query string.
  • Medium: mobile dashboard has horizontal overflow (709 px scroll width at a 390 px viewport).
  • Medium: Expense page is blank and calls return 404/500.
  • Medium: People directory shows access-level API errors and an "Unable to generate Default Access" console error.
  • Medium: Attendance Configuration reports an invalid Google Maps key, affecting geofencing/address features.
  • Medium: Approvals page is blank.
  • Low: Forgot Password modal has no visible close control, does not close on Esc, and keeps aria-hidden="true" while open.
  • Low: production console logs token/debug messages; Appcues integration reports an expired account; some legacy font assets return 404.

2. Scope and constraints

Completed

  • Public login page, validation, Forgot Password, SSO, and mobile login.
  • Authenticated Admin login, dashboard, Action Center, sidebar navigation, and logout.
  • People: Info, Employees directory, OED report.
  • Settings: Employee Fields, Employee ID, Company Directory, Share Company Access, Training, Access Levels, Approvals, Public Holiday, Dashboard Configuration, Custom Notifications.
  • Attendance: Dashboard, Roster, Reports, Administration, Configuration.
  • Additional accessible routes: Expense, Appraisal, Recruitment, Custom Forms, Knowledge Hub, Reports, User Admin.
  • Mobile dashboard layout check.
  • Post-logout direct-URL access check.

Not completed / constrained

  • No create, edit, delete, submit, approve, reject, clock-in/out, payroll run, or settings change.
  • No employee, payroll, claim, or report exports/downloads.
  • No employee or manager role testing; Admin account only.
  • No transactional UAT, payroll processing, approval routing, or end-to-end workflow validation.
  • No wrong-password or account-lockout testing, to avoid locking the production Admin account.
  • No full 60-minute idle-timeout wait; client storage indicated an idle expiry of approximately 60 minutes.
  • No cross-browser testing beyond Chromium.
  • No formal accessibility audit.

Recommendation

  1. Do not start full-suite UAT yet. Confirm the intended scope because the tenant does not expose the full JustLogin suite.
  2. Fix or accept PRE-UAT-001 (OED) and PRE-UAT-002 (privacy) before UAT entry.
  3. Fix the mobile dashboard, Expense, Approvals, People access-level errors, and Attendance Maps key if those areas are in scope.
  4. Run transactional UAT in a non-production tenant with employee, manager/approver, and HR roles. Production read-only access cannot validate leave, claims, approvals, clocking, or payroll processing.
  5. Populate or confirm expected master data for Employee Fields.
  6. Remove the temporary password file after testing and rotate the Admin password if it was shared outside the approved secret channel.

Appendix B — Credential handling

  • The password was read from a restricted local secret file for the test session.
  • The password is not recorded in this report, the evidence, or the repository.
  • The authenticated session state file should be removed after review.
  • The temporary password file should be deleted after testing, or the Admin password should be rotated if it was shared beyond the approved secret channel.
